title: Sales Manager
description:
Job Description\-
 



  





 • Prospect relentlessly to build pipeline and build strong relationships with prospects
 



 • Own the experience we give every prospective customer from the first time they interact with us
 



 • Be responsible for achieving sales targets by working with a talented group of interiors designers • Create reliable forecasts and be completely transparent with management on the pipeline status • Close new business consistently at or above quota level Develop and execute on a strategic plan for the showroom / offline business unit and document and distribute competitive information
 



 • Be proactive about solving problems even if it's outside of your area and be ready to take on additional initiatives and responsibilities as they emerge
 



 • Seek out opportunities to be a leader and do everything you can to help the company achieve its larger objectives World\-class customer experience is what we pride ourselves on. Hence, we will expect you to share our passion and commitment for serving customers.
 



 • The ideal candidate for this role will come with past experience in managing relationships with customers and running a sales team, with clear sales targets.
 



 • We are a fast\-growing startup (2000\+ projects completed) and expect all our colleagues to be flexible, action and results oriented self\-starters with strong data analysis skills.
 



 • We are heavily biased towards candidates who come with a proven track record of taking ownership, understanding customer pain\-points, driving results and moving with speed to implement ideas in a fast\-paced environment.
 



 • Lastly, we are looking for effective communicators who can work effortlessly with customers, colleagues, business partners and vendors, alike
 



  





 Expertise and Qualifications\-
 



  





 • 4\-8 years of Sales experience
 



 • 2 years of team handling experience
 



 • Graduate / Post graduate
 



 • Excellent verbal and written communications skills
 



 • Strong listening and presentation skills
 



 • Ability to multitask, prioritize, and manage time effectively
 



 • Understanding of home interiors domain a bonus

title: Business Development Executive
description:
Allwin Medical Devices is a leading manufacturer of medical devices across Women’s Health and IVF, Urology, Gastroenterology, and Interventional Radiology. Headquartered in Anaheim, California, the company is committed to providing customers with high\-quality medical devices at affordable prices. Our founders have more than 30 years of combined experience in the medical\-device industry.
 



  





 For more information, please visit:
 **allwinmedical.com** 




 Position Details
 



**Designation:** 
 Business Development Executive / Manager
 



**Department:** 
 Sales
 



**Locations:** 
 Mumbai, Pune, Hyderabad, and Chennai
 



  





**Qualifications and Experience** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Sales, or a related field
* Three to five years of sales or business\-development experience
* At least three years of experience in the medical\-device, IVF, or pharmaceutical industry
* Experience managing distributors and regional sales is preferred



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Manage sales activities for the company’s product portfolio within the assigned region.
* Develop and carry out regional sales plans that support company policies and business goals.
* Set and manage monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets.
* Identify new business opportunities and develop relationships with hospitals, clinics, healthcare professionals, distributors, and key accounts.
* Appoint new distributors and support their development within the assigned region.
* Provide product guidance, sales support, and coaching to distributors to improve their performance.
* Monitor distributor sales, market coverage, inventory, and customer activity.
* Work closely with internal departments to support customers and improve sales results.
* Act as the main link between the head office and field teams to ensure clear and timely communication.
* Prepare regional sales forecasts, performance analysis, and regular reports.
* Monitor and report issues affecting regional performance, including pricing, competition, market trends, distributor performance, staffing, and customer concerns.
* Recommend actions to address market challenges and improve sales performance.
* Support regional, divisional, and individual sales planning and target\-setting.
* Coordinate with corporate and key accounts when field support is required within the assigned region.
* Represent the company at customer meetings, product demonstrations, conferences, exhibitions, and other industry events.
* Ensure that all sales activities follow company policies and applicable industry requirements.



  





**Required Skills** 



* Strong communication, presentation, and negotiation skills
* Fluent in English and the relevant local language
* Strong relationship\-building and distributor\-management skills
* Results\-oriented and able to meet sales targets
* Proactive, persistent, and comfortable with field\-based work
* Good planning, forecasting, and reporting skills
* Ability to work independently and coordinate with different teams
* Willingness to travel regularly within the assigned region

title: Senior Sales Executive
description:
Job Title: Sr. Sales Executive – Media Sales
 



  
 



 Experience
 



 Minimum 5 years of experience in Media Sales, Advertising Sales, OOH Sales, or Corporate Sales.
 



 Qualification
 



 Graduated in any discipline
 



 Job Summary
 



 We are seeking a highly motivated Senior Sales Executive to drive new business and revenue growth. The role focuses exclusively on identifying, prospecting, and acquiring new direct clients. The candidate will be responsible for generating leads, conducting client meetings, presenting solutions, negotiating commercials, closing deals, and ensuring timely collections for the business. This is a pure hunting role with a strong focus on achieving sales targets and expanding the company's client base.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



 Generate revenue by selling the company's advertising inventory to direct clients.
 



 Identify prospective clients and schedule meetings and presentations.
 



 Understand client requirements and propose suitable media solutions.
 



 Prepare proposals, negotiate commercials, and close deals.
 



 Achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets.
 



 Ensure timely receipt of purchase orders and required documentation.
 



 Follow up on outstanding payments and collections.
 



 Maintain a healthy sales pipeline and provide regular sales reports.
 



 Stay updated on market trends, competitor activities, and industry developments.
 



 Coordinate with internal teams for smooth campaign execution.
 



  
 



 Reporting
 



 Maintain records of client meetings, proposals, and sales closures.
 



 Submit regular sales activity and revenue reports.
 



 Update sales forecasts and pipeline status.
 



 Required Skills
 



 Strong sales and negotiation skills.
 



 Excellent communication and presentation abilities.
 



 Relationship\-building and client management skills.
 



 Result\-oriented with a focus on achieving targets.
 



 Proficiency in MS Office.
